# Zameen.com Pakistan Property Price & Area Scraper

Zameen.com is Pakistan's largest property portal, listing apartments, houses, plots, and commercial space for sale and rent across the country's major cities. This actor searches that catalog by city, purpose, and category, or fetches a specific set of listings by ID or URL, returning price, size, rooms, amenities, and location for each result.

## What this actor does

- **Search for sale or for rent** across 10 major Pakistani cities (Lahore, Karachi, Islamabad, Rawalpindi, Faisalabad, Multan, Peshawar, Quetta, Sialkot, Gujranwala)
- **Category filter** — apartments, houses, plots, or commercial, or any category combined
- **Bedroom and price filters** — minimum bedrooms and a price range in Pakistani Rupees
- **Direct lookup** — fetch specific listings by their Zameen.com property ID or URL
- **Location detail** — city, area, and neighborhood, parsed from the listing's own location hierarchy
- Fields a listing doesn't publish (e.g. no amenities list, no verification badge) are left out of the record rather than sent as empty values

## Output per property

- `propertyId`, `referenceNumber`
- `title`
- `purpose` — `for-sale` or `for-rent`
- `propertyType` — the listing's specific category (e.g. Apartment, House, Plot, Office)
- `price` — in Pakistani Rupees (PKR)
- `bedrooms`, `bathrooms`
- `areaSqFt` — listed size in square feet
- `city`, `area`, `neighborhood`
- `imageUrl` — cover photo
- `photoCount` — number of photos on the listing
- `amenities[]` — e.g. parking, lawn, security
- `furnishing` — furnishing status, when stated
- `completionStatus` — e.g. ready, under construction
- `isVerified` — whether Zameen.com has verified the listing
- `propertyUrl`
- `listedAt` — when the listing was created
- `scrapedAt`

## Input

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | string | `searchBuy` | `searchBuy` / `searchRent` / `searchByCity` / `propertyDetails` — `searchByCity` searches the same for-sale listings as `searchBuy`, just framed around the `city` field |
| `city` | string | `Lahore` | One of 10 curated Pakistani cities |
| `category` | string | `apartments` | `any` / `apartments` / `houses` / `plots` / `commercial` |
| `bedrooms` | integer | – | Minimum number of bedrooms (1–10) |
| `minPrice` | integer | – | Minimum price filter in PKR |
| `maxPrice` | integer | – | Maximum price filter in PKR |
| `propertyIds` | array | `[]` | Zameen.com property IDs or URLs (mode=`propertyDetails`) |
| `maxItems` | integer | `20` | Maximum number of listings to return (1–500) |

### Example: apartments for sale in Lahore

```json
{
  "mode": "searchBuy",
  "city": "Lahore",
  "category": "apartments",
  "bedrooms": 2,
  "maxItems": 30
}
```

### Example: houses for rent in Karachi within a budget

```json
{
  "mode": "searchRent",
  "city": "Karachi",
  "category": "houses",
  "maxPrice": 150000,
  "maxItems": 30
}
```

### Example: fetch specific listings by ID or URL

```json
{
  "mode": "propertyDetails",
  "propertyIds": [
    "https://www.zameen.com/Property/123456.html",
    "789012"
  ]
}
```

## Use cases

- **Market research** — compare asking prices across categories and cities
- **Price monitoring** — track a set of specific listings over time by re-running `propertyDetails` with the same IDs
- **Investment screening** — filter for budget and bedroom count to shortlist candidate properties in a city
- **Portfolio tracking** — pull your own or a competitor's active listings by ID
- **Rental market analysis** — compare rent levels for a property type across cities

## FAQ

**Is this affiliated with Zameen.com?**
No. This is an independent third-party actor that reads Zameen.com's own publicly available listing data; it is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Zameen.com.

**What's the difference between `searchBuy` and `searchByCity`?**
None in practice — both search for-sale listings using the same `city`, `category`, and price/bedroom filters. `searchByCity` is kept as an alternate entry point for the same search.

**What currency are prices shown in?**
Pakistani Rupees (PKR), as published on the listing.

**Why is `bedrooms` or `bathrooms` missing on some listings?**
Not every listing (particularly plots and commercial properties) has a room count to report — the field is left out rather than shown as zero.

**How do I fetch a specific listing's details?**
Use `mode=propertyDetails` with `propertyIds` set to either the full Zameen.com listing URL or its numeric property ID.

**Why did my search return 0 results?**
The combination of city, category, and price/bedroom filters may simply have no matching active listings right now. Try widening the price range or removing the bedroom filter.

**Is `isVerified` the same as agency-confirmed?**
`isVerified` reflects Zameen.com's own verification badge on the listing; it isn't independent confirmation by this actor.
